practical_decision_support.rationale: Practical steps but no quote-ready specifications

b2b_commercial_relevance.rationale: Direct and relevant apparel seller audience

executive_summary.strengths: Provides a five-step selection framework including garment fit, finish, order model and seasonal scheduling, plus useful product examples.
executive_summary.critical_findings: Contains blanket packaging material and garment-protection claims, arbitrary half-inch allowance, inconsistent category comparisons and several unsupported commercial guarantees.
executive_summary.recommended_corrections: Qualify structural/protection claims; define measured clearance based on garment and insert; clarify stock/custom versus purchase-quantity distinctions; add sample approval and realistic lead-time guidance.
